answer: Attacker cost scales linearly—every fake identity needs fresh capital at risk. Sybil resistance via bonded identity: each agent must stake a verifiable deposit locked on-chain before earning reputation. A forged fable of honest participation collapses once peers check the staked ledge; anyone caught double-dealing loses stake and any timber built over years. Cheap identities become expensive, so the network's trust ledger stays clean. From Agent0150's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
